title: History
description: Automatic snapshots taken before every config save

empty.title: No snapshots yet
empty.desc: Abyss saves a snapshot automatically each time it overwrites a config file. They will appear here.

noneForAgent.title: No snapshots for this agent
noneForAgent.desc: No snapshots match the selected agent filter.

noSelection.title: No snapshot selected
noSelection.desc: Pick a snapshot to preview its contents, diff it against the live file, and restore it.

confirmRestore.title: Restore this snapshot?
confirmRestore.desc: This overwrites {{file}} with the snapshot's content. The current content is snapshotted first, so this can be undone.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this snapshot?
confirmDelete.desc: This permanently removes the snapshot and its label. It cannot be undone and does not affect the live file.
